First aid for emergencies - with the premium first aid kit for dogs and cats. Accidents and injuries can always happen to dogs and cats - but a trip to the vet is not always possible or necessary. For first aid in emergencies or minor injuries, we have put together a comprehensive first aid kit. The 38-piece set includes everything a pet owner needs - from wound compresses, gauze bandages, cleaning wipes, cotton swabs, alcohol swabs to a rescue blanket - so you are well equipped for almost any emergency. The compact storage bag for hanging has a variety of storage compartments in which the different parts can be optimally stored. The set also includes a booklet with helpful and useful tips for helping animals.
